thread:
Jules (Collections): ByteWave INV-2026-612 is 31 days past due. Amount $27,450. Customer claims platform bug caused hourly spike. They refuse full payment until we issue credit. Need recommendation: payment hold + conditional plan or escalate.
Aria (Acct Exec): Had a call — Tom admits a retry loop in their batch job, but also noticed 3rd-party connector failures. They're asking for a 40% credit and to pay the remainder over 30 days.
Tom (ByteWave Billing): We accept responsibility for the job but want a fair split. Proposal: we pay 50% now, 25% in 15 days, 25% in 30 days. We'll sign a settlement and provide logs.
Jules (Collections): Collections prefers at least 60% upfront. We're okay to accept split if Legal signs off on waiver for this incident and we get ACH on file.
Lena (Finance Ops): Finance needs credits >$10k routed to CFO. Any credit reduces recognised revenue; delay reversal until credit memo approved. Also require AR ticket.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft a short settlement: credit amount, payment schedule, one-time waiver for this incident, and a clause preserving right to dispute other charges. Send me the agreed numbers.
Tom (ByteWave Billing): Ok to 60% today, 40% over 30 days if we get the credit memo for the overage portion. We'll wire the first payment upon receipt of revised invoice.
billing-bot: Invoice updated: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-612.pdf (status: past_due).
Jules (Collections): Action items: 1) Aria send updated invoice with credit line 2) Priya prepare settlement addendum 3) ByteWave to provide ACH last4 and remittance 4) Collections to wait 72h before escalation.
Aria (Acct Exec): Sending invoice + credit draft to billing@bytewave.com now. ETA CFO signature EOD.
billing-bot: Payment attempt recorded: $16,470 via ACH last4 1122  pending.
Jules (Collections): Marking thread monitored. If payment doesn't clear by 1783004722 we'll escalate. Thanks all.
